launch.title: Publish your trip
launch.body: Travelling soon? Your spare kilos can pay for your ticket. You announce, you get requests, you choose.
launch.point1: You set your price per kilo and the kilos you lend.
launch.point2: You say what you accept to carry, and what you refuse.
launch.point3: You are paid four days after delivery, no haggling.
launch.resumeBody: {route} — pick up where you left off.

mode.title: How are you travelling?
mode.subtitle: The transport mode decides which handover places we will offer you.
mode.stopsHint: Separate them with a comma. They appear on your listing.
mode.PLANE_hint: Handover at the airport or in town
mode.TRAIN_hint: Handover at the station or in town
mode.CAR_hint: Handover in town, within a radius

route.title: Your route
route.subtitle: These two cities are how shippers will find you.

when.title: When do you leave?
when.subtitle: The date is the first filter shippers use.
when.referenceHint: It unlocks the “Verified trip” badge once Yamba checks it. Shippers never see it.

city.unavailable: Suggestions unavailable — what you typed still works

missing.escales: Name the cities you travel through
missing.memeVille: Departure and arrival are the same city
missing.dateDepartPassee: That departure date is in the past
missing.forfaitSoute: The checked-bag rate must be above 0
missing.forfaitCabine: The cabin-bag rate must be above 0
missing.lieuRemise: Offer at least one pickup place
missing.lieuLivraison: Offer at least one delivery place

price.title: Your price and your kilos
price.subtitle: You set it. What you announce is what you get.
price.floorHint: Light parcel (envelope, passport, glasses…): no shipment ever earns you less than {kg, number} kg × your rate.
price.gainTitle: If your {kg, number} kg all go
price.gainHint: net, paid four days after delivery

families.title: What you accept
families.subtitle: By default you take everything. Refuse or surcharge what you would rather not carry.
families.someRefused: {refused, number} refused, {surcharged, number} with a surcharge
families.bagsSubtitle: A fixed price for a full suitcase, instead of the price per kilo.
families.bagSuspended: Suspended: your capacity ({capacity, number} kg) cannot hold {kg, number} kg.

places.title: Where the handover happens
places.subtitle: Two moments: the parcel is handed to you at departure, collected on arrival.
places.pickupTitle: In {city}, the parcel is handed to you
places.pickupTitleFallback: At departure, the parcel is handed to you
places.noMode: Pick your transport mode first: the handover places depend on it.

review.title: Check and publish
review.subtitle: This is what shippers will see of your trip.
review.refusedCount: {count, plural, =0 {No family refused} one {# family refused} other {# families refused}}
review.surchargedCount: {count, plural, =0 {} one {# with a surcharge} other {# with a surcharge}}
review.handDeliveryHint: No drop-off at a third party, no key box.
review.instantBookingHint: Requests are accepted without you having to answer.
review.notesPlaceholder: I fly from T2E, I answer quickly in the evening…
review.errorGeneric: Try again in a moment. If it persists, the trip was not created.
review.errorNEW_ACCOUNT_CAP: Your account is still new: the number of open trips is limited for now.
review.errorACCOUNT_RESTRICTED: Your account cannot publish at the moment.
